title: Great set with everything you need!
text: Great set with everything you need!. This is a slick bartender set at a great price. I was looking for something to use in my new bar area and this certainly fits the bill. Contains everything you need to make the perfect drink. I think this would make a great gift for a bridal shower or even a housewarming gift because it is unique and practical. I love the wood base as well that makes storage a breeze (and it looks great in my home). Highly recommend!
